Net Promoter Score (NPS) measures customer loyalty and brand sentiment on a scale from -100 to 100.[[1]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/nps-calculator/)

### The NPS Formula

NPS=%Promoters−%Detractors NPS equals % Promoters minus % Detractors N P S=%P r o m o t e r s−%D e t r a c t o r s  

### How to Categorize Responses

Survey respondents score your business from 0 to 10:[[1]](https://npscalculator.com/)

- **Promoters (Score 9–10):** Loyal enthusiasts who keep buying and refer others.
- **Passives (Score 7–8):** Satisfied but unenthusiastic customers who are vulnerable to competitors. (They are excluded from the final NPS math).
- **Detractors (Score 0–6):** Unhappy customers who can damage your brand.[[1]](https://www.zoho.com/survey/net-promoter-score-calculator.html)[[2]](https://survicate.com/nps-calculator/)[[3]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/net-promoter-score-calculation/)

### Step-by-Step Calculation

1. **Count** the total number of survey responses.
2. **Calculate the percentage** of Promoters (Number of Promoters / Total Responses × 100).
3. **Calculate the percentage** of Detractors (Number of Detractors / Total Responses × 100).
4. **Subtract** the Detractor percentage from the Promoter percentage.[[1]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/net-promoter-score-calculation/)[[2]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/nps-calculator/)[[3]](https://shout.com/nps-calculator/)

*(Note: If you are looking for the Indian **National Pension System (NPS)** retirement calculator instead, you can check the NPS Calculator - National Pension System Calculator | Online Pension Calculator from SBI Securities).* [[1]](https://www.sbisecurities.in/calculators/nps-calculator)If you want, share your **number of Promoters, Passives, and Detractors** , and I can calculate your exact score for you.
